prompts.1: Write freely about your stories and/or specific moments from your past — no rules, your way.
prompts.2:
What feelings from this story do you still carry with you (good or bad)? What effects, symptoms, reflections — or anything else — still resonate in the present? In what way?

Express them however you see fit.
prompts.3:
Do you feel it's time to let go of these feelings? It can be all of them, just one, or maybe none — that's okay, honor your time. You can always come back here.

If you have any to release, thank them for what they taught you, but it's time to let them go. Holding on only creates resentment and entrapment.
